plugins.name: n3mc-workingmemory-mcp
plugins.description: Ephemeral (7-day TTL) hybrid vector + BM25 memory MCP server for Claude Code, backed by Redis Stack. Multilingual (NFKC + bigram for CJK / Hangul / Thai / Lao / Myanmar / Khmer + diacritic fold). Requires a Redis Stack container running on localhost:6379 and uv (for uvx) on PATH.

plugins.name: n3mc-workingmemory
plugins.description: Full recall: the same MCP server plus hooks that save every message and reply and add matching memories to every turn. Ephemeral (7-day TTL), backed by Redis Stack. Requires a Redis Stack container running on localhost:6379 and uv (for uvx) on PATH. Do not enable it together with n3mc-workingmemory-mcp.
